strategies.name: Model-favored road dog
strategies.rule: Back the road team when the archived market line makes it a ≥ +3 underdog but the EPA-margin model projects the road side to win by ≥ 2 after rest adjustment.

strategies.name: Model-vs-market total under
strategies.rule: Take the under when the archived market total is ≥ 44 and the EPA total model projects ≤ market − 2.

strategies.name: OL deficiency under
strategies.rule: Take the under when either team has ≥ 2 offensive-line starters (depth rank 1) listed Out on the week's official injury report.

strategies.name: Secondary deficiency over
strategies.rule: Take the over when either defense has ≥ 2 secondary starters (depth rank 1) listed Out.

strategies.name: Rest differential road side
strategies.rule: Back the road team when it has ≥ 4 more days rest than home and the model projects ≥ −1 margin (near pick-em).
